description: The map's messages: the keys by message number from "first" (the numbers before it are common.json's), and the English text of the original game.

strings.map5_s03.theres_a_crack_something:
There's a crack.
Something glints inside.
strings.map5_s03.the_crack_is_too_small:
The crack is too small
to reach in.{end}
strings.map5_s03.looks_like_its_been_sitting:
Looks like it's been sitting
here for years.
strings.map5_s03.the_dust_is_wiped_away:
The dust is wiped away
just around the gas tank cap.{end}
strings.map5_s03.a_small_glass_vial_wrapped:
A small glass vial,
wrapped in a plastic bag.
strings.map5_s03.instead_of_messing_with_that:
{wait1 3.3}Instead of messing with that,
how about coming up with a way
to get out of here?
strings.map5_s03.you_shouldnt_be_hanging_around:
{wait1 2.6}You shouldn't be hanging
around here goofing off!
strings.map5_s03.what_do_you_think_you:
{wait1 1.3}What do you think
you are doing?
strings.map5_s03.you_want_to_get_yourself:
{wait1 3.0}You want to get yourself killed!?
Get outta here!
strings.map5_s03.unless_you_want_to_die:
{wait1 3.2}Unless you want to die,
keep your mind on business.
strings.map5_s03.that_guys_gotta_be_involved:
{wait1 3.3}That guy's gotta be involved
in the local drug racket.
strings.map5_s03.man_was_he_pissed_and:
{wait1 3.1}Man, was he pissed.
And in such a rush, too.
strings.map5_s03.that_was_probably_dope_in:
{wait1 1.8}That was probably dope
in the bottle.
strings.map5_s03.man_was_he_pissed_and_2:
{wait1 3.1}Man, was he pissed.
And in such a rush, too.{end}
strings.map5_s03.its_the_same_date_as:
It's the same date as
the one in the hospital...{end}
strings.map5_s03.investigation_stalled_ptv:
{pos 4}{color 3}Investigation stalled.
[PTV] dealers still at large.

Suspicious deaths continue.
Like the anti-drug mayor,
a narcotics officer dies of
a sudden heart failure of
unknown origin.{end}
strings.map5_s03.took_package_told_to_sit:
{color 3}Took package.
Told to sit on it awhile.
strings.map5_s03.dont_want_to_get_involved:
{color 3}Don't want to get involved,
but can't disobey...
strings.map5_s03.hes_probably_linked_to_the:
{color 3}He's probably linked to the death
of the mayor and others.{end}
strings.map5_s03.batteries_oil_cans_and_other:
Batteries, oil cans,
and other items line the shelves.
strings.map5_s03.theres_a_radio_on_top:
There's a radio
on top of the cabinet.
strings.map5_s03.its_completely_dead_maybe_its:
It's completely dead.
Maybe it's broken.{end}
strings.map5_s03.a_poster_is_on_the:
A poster is on the wall.
Don't look at that now, though.{end}
strings.map5_s03.the_power_must_be_out:
The power must be out.
It doesn't work.{end}
strings.map5_s03.theres_a_guest_register:
There's a guest register.
Nothing special written here.{end}
strings.map5_s03.theres_a_vending_machine_it:
There's a vending machine.
It doesn't work.{end}
strings.map5_s03.do_you_want_to_push:
Do you want to push
the shelf?{choice 4}
